sourceDescription: Two AI-generated bitmap illustrations approved by the user, developed from a user-supplied Dune: Part Two kangaroo mouse still and existing Dune Zone creature decals.

request.scope: The user approved both attached bitmaps and requested vector decals in the appropriate collection.

preparation.paletteAssignment: Nearest RGB palette entry. The multicolor layers use the cleaned alpha silhouette, an olive-or-cream mask and a cream mask, painted in that order to avoid seams.
preparation.trace: Potrace 1.16 SVG output, turdsize 8, alphamax 1.0, opttolerance 0.25. Dune Zone authoring provenance, uniform square normalization and category optimization follow tracing.

/vector/decal/muaddib.svg.paint: Inherited from the caller; internal details are transparent cutouts. No perimeter outline is added.

/vector/decal/muaddib-multicolor.svg.paint: Three fixed opaque colors matching the existing creature decal palette.
